full_text_tesim: ... ܒܘܟܪܘܬܐ. ܐܡ̇ܪ ܠܗ ܝܥܩܘܒ. ܐܝܡܝ ܠܝ ܝܘܡܢܐ
Four contiguous folios of an otherwise lost codex
Liturgical rubric in a later Melkite hand (f. 2r)
No visible quire signatures suggest that the outer bifolium is wanting.
Palimpsest folios in Greek (ff. 2, 3) and CPA (ff. 1, 4)
Pencil foliation on the top left of each recto was added after imaging, in accordance with Philothée
Serto with coexistence of Estrangela "olaf" ; Transitional Serto
